items.title: Joe Lyde Interview, 1959-05-18
items.q: I forget, Wettling was on drums. No, was he, no, wait a minute, no, a younger chap. I heard him another time, he was on drums.

ctx.x: That's right. I know, I could tell you that, I forget, Wettling was on drums. No, was he, no, wait a minute, no, a younger chap. I heard him another time, he was on drums. No, it was a younger chap on drums. A colored bass player, fat fellow with a white goatee, and I think Schroeder on piano. I think that was it, and Condon didn't play it all the whole evening. Then I got the bus down here.
Yeah. Well, anyway, when you were home in Ireland, when you came over here, your purpose, I mean, you were going, you were coming to New Orleans with just those few little stop-offs.
